Emotion-aware text generation and speech synthesis

projects.title: AI-Powered Intelligent CCTV Surveillance System
projects.type: Computer Vision System | AI Analytics Platform
projects.description: An advanced AI-driven surveillance system designed to analyze and interpret CCTV video streams in real time. The platform integrates computer vision, deep learning, and multi-camera tracking techniques to detect, track, and analyze people, vehicles, and incidents across large surveillance environments. The system reconstructs movement trajectories across multiple cameras, predicts possible paths in areas without camera coverage, and enables efficient search and analysis of historical surveillance data.
highlights: Real-time detection and tracking of people and vehicles from multiple CCTV streams
Cross-camera object re-identification to follow the same entity across different locations
Movement trajectory reconstruction and visualization using spatial mapping
Path prediction in blind-spot regions where cameras are not available
AI-based incident detection including abnormal behavior and restricted-area intrusion
Interactive map visualization showing movement paths and activity heatmaps
Historical video search using object attributes and event-based queries
Scalable architecture capable of handling distributed surveillance networks

highlights: Multi-format resume processing (PDF, DOCX, TXT)
NLP-based entity extraction using spaCy
Automatic extraction of education, experience, skills, and projects
Structured JSON generation for downstream applications
Advanced date parsing and profile link extraction
OCR text cleaning and section-aware document analysis

projects.description: An end-to-end data analytics and forecasting pipeline designed to identify emerging job roles, in-demand skills, and high-growth industries by combining job market data, search-interest signals, NLP processing, and time-series forecasting to support recruitment and workforce planning decisions.

NLP-based extraction of skills, roles, and industries
Demand forecasting using Prophet, SARIMAX, and LSTM
Scenario analysis with best-case, worst-case, and likely outcomes
Backtesting and model validation using forecasting metrics
Automated generation of 17 analytical visualizations

projects.title: Sherlock Holmes RAG System

The system retrieves relevant story passages and generates context-aware answers using Gemini LLM.
highlights: RAG pipeline implemented using LangChain
Semantic search over the 62 original Sherlock Holmes stories
FastAPI-based REST API for AI question answering
LLM-powered responses using Gemini models
Automated data extraction from Arthur Conan Doyle Encyclopedia
